description:
I am writing to formally request planning permission to increase the height of my driveway front gate, walls, and railings, which fall within 3 meters of the highway/road edges at 77, Devonshire Road E16 3NL.

Current Situation:
The existing wall height is 1 meter (3 feet 3 inches). Out of three 3 meter, pathway width, the distance from highway/Road edge to boundary wall is 2.23 meter ( 7 feet and 3 inches) . The area development permission needed was on 0.77 meter ( 2 feet and five inches). 

The proposed modifications include:
A driveway gate height of 4 feet 6 inches.
Side walls at 4 feet with an additional 6-inch railing on top (totalling 4 feet 6 inches).
This requires an additional 15 inches (1 foot 3 inches) in height compared to the current structure. For the area 0.77 meter that falls w

Justification for the Request:
Safety Concerns for Child with Autism:
My child has autism and tends to throw toys, then lean over the existing wall to retrieve them, posing a serious health and safety risk and risk of head injury to child. Also child would run from driveway into road, running cars poses poenitentia risk of harm to child. Gate installed with right height would provide child safe area to play and move around. The proposed height increase is the minimum necessary to prevent potential harm and ensure a secure environment for my child to play safely.

Consistency with Council-Installed Fencing:
In front of  the left side of the properties Nos. 79–93, the council has installed a 1.3-meter (approx. 4 feet 3 inches) green fence.
The requested gate height (4 feet 6 inches) aligns closely with this existing council fencing.

Highway & Visibility Considerations:
Devonshire Road is a closed-end street. The modification will not obstruct visibility or access, as the increase is minimal and serves a critical safeguarding purpose.

Supporting Context:
The council has previously granted us permission for a kerb drop, which has been completed.
The installation of a secure gate is the next necessary step to ensure the driveway remains safe for my child with needs. 

Request for Compassionate Consideration:
Given the council’s duty of care toward children with additional needs, I kindly request approval for this modification to mitigate a clear safety risk. I would be grateful for your support in facilitating a safer environment for my child.

Please let me know if any further details or documentation are required. I appreciate your time and consideration and look forward to your positive response.
